evidence: Every reject/hide/absent/unchanged leg in the shipped criteria is paired, inside the same criterion, with a matching success on an eligible target, and functional/prompt.md adds a global rule: 'Every refusal pairs with a success of the same kind on an eligible target, in the same criterion' plus 'A criterion passes only if every numbered leg and every listed positive control holds'. Examples: render gate pairs 'nothing private before sign-in / incorrect password rejected' with Gwen's successful sign-in showing matters (gates/render/judge.toml:28-30); signin_and_client_scope records list/thread/mentions/search/transcript requests as explicit positive controls before signed-out replays, and pairs Gwen's cross-client M-12 post replay with her working M-11 post (functional/judge.toml:46-50); wall_every_route pairs Dev's empty M-12 results with Sian's thread/search/transcript seeing JUDGE-W0 and Dev's own reply JUDGE-W1 working (60-66); wall_mentions_and_links pairs Dev's not-available preview with Harriet's working preview, absent JUDGE-M1 with present JUDGE-M2, excluded suggestions with included names (76-81); wall_added_live pairs refusals with Sian's pre-wall post and the lift restoring JUDGE-WL0 (91-96); deleted_and_expired pairs the exact-7-day deletion with the 1-second-younger survivor and Sian's refused delete with Gwen's delete (119-127); timer_changes pairs vanished probate/JUDGE-TE with recorded earlier-versions, held 'executor' found in search/transcript, Sian's refused timer change with Harriet's (137-143); hold_scope_and_release has explicit delete and search positive controls (153-158); edits_and_stale_edit pairs stale/hijack refusals with the first edit and Sian's M-13 visibility, and mention-removal with mention-add (170-178); safe_formatting, message_links, unread (0 then 2), sent_once (D2 control), live_updates, search_and_transcript (Part C '1000 pounds' control) and persistence step c are likewise paired. Polish delete_confirm pairs decline with confirm, refusal_in_place pairs wrong password with right password. Broken-app probe: a blank/empty/login-only app fails every functional criterion because each requires an observed positive (posted text visible, search hit, preview, count) and the global gate requires Gwen's protected content. Conforming-alternative probe: no leg demands a specific refusal form beyond 'plain not-available'; empty list/error/not-available are all accepted for the earlier-versions replay (139). Minor Note (not a defect): polish escape_closes (polish/judge.toml:35) credits 'closes without saving' without a successful save in the same criterion, but its credited behaviour is the active Escape-closes action required by conversations.md:29, so a dead app cannot earn it. Run verdict NOT EXERCISED: no weak-app/discrimination run exists on these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope); this row is decided from criterion text, so that gap does not change this verdict.
